description: Search Goofish / Xianyu (闲鱼) secondhand & luxury listings by single keyword or multi-keyword array, with cross-keyword deduplication, pagination up to 100 items, offline English-to-Chinese Xianyu slang translation, USD markdown math, and Superbuy/AllChinaBuy links.

cnyToUsdRate.description: CNY-to-USD conversion rate used to compute estimated USD prices (default 0.138).

detailLevel.description: Extraction depth: 'summary' (fast ~1.5s listing cards, default) or 'full' (deep item specs and unmasked seller metrics).

freeShipping.description: Return only listings offering free domestic shipping within China.

keyword.description: Single search keyword (e.g. '索尼 A7C2', 'Sony mirrorless', 'Switch OLED'). Optional if keywords array is provided.

keywords.description: Optional list of keywords for multi-keyword search with automatic cross-keyword itemId deduplication.

maxItems.description: Maximum deduplicated listings to return (1-100, default 10).

personalOnly.description: Filter individual personal sellers only and exclude commercial resellers.

priceMax.description: Maximum listing price filter in CNY (¥).

priceMin.description: Minimum listing price filter in CNY (¥).

region.description: Optional Chinese city or province filter (e.g. '上海', '深圳', '广东').

sortBy.description: Server-side sort order for Goofish search results (default 'newest').

translateKeywords.description: Translate English product and Xianyu slang terms (e.g. 'box and papers' -> '箱说全') into Simplified Chinese.

name: search_goofish_items
title: Search Goofish (Xianyu) Listings
